verbs.name: inspect.media
verbs.description: Inspect registered media in the open project through a bounded path-light read model. Returns current asset identity, availability, media shape, and cited-evidence coverage without source paths, provider data, analysis execution, UI navigation, or project mutation. This is the agent-facing projection of the same current project and MediaEvidenceIndex@1 authorities used by Find > Moment.

asset_ids.description: Optional exact registered project asset ids. Omit for all project media, bounded to the first 100 assets.

verbs.result: MediaInspection@1 {schema, project_revision, index_id?, count, assets:[{asset_id, content_hash, available, media_kind, duration_ms?, has_video, has_audio, evidence:{kind:{source,indexed,state}}}]} — current project/index authorities, no source paths

verbs.name: inspect.range
verbs.description: Resolve up to 12 opaque EvidenceHit@1 ids against the current MediaEvidenceIndex@1 and current project authorities. Returns the exact current source ranges, provenance hashes, availability, and live bounded timeline occurrences in request order. An optional index_id makes a UI-selected attachment fail closed if the index changed before inspection. Missing, stale, foreign-project, or changed evidence is refused rather than summarized from an old prompt. Read-only: never opens media, moves the playhead, sends a chat turn, or edits the project.

evidence_ids.description: Opaque evidence ids returned by media.intelligence_search.

index_id.description: Optional exact index snapshot expected by the caller. Evidence attachments always supply it.

verbs.result: EvidenceInspection@1 {schema, index_id, count, hits:[EvidenceHit@1]} — the same evidence identity and current source/timeline citations used by Find > Moment
